_about: Medical reviewer credit for the Skingenetix science pages. Added 2026-09-22 on Malcolm's instruction ('Lets already add Esther Bodde as verified. I will check with her'), BEFORE Dr Bodde has read the pages. Malcolm is confirming with her. If she declines or asks for changes, take it off everywhere with: python3 scripts/set-reviewer.py configs/reviewers/esther-bodde.json --remove --apply. Credential wording is Malcolm's decision of 2026-09-22 (docs/todo.md CONTENT-001: 'Dr. Esther Bodde, Cosmetic & Medical Physician'). The sister brand's 'Cosmetic & Plastic Surgeon' is flagged there as possibly inaccurate, so it is not used. The credential stays in English in every locale: a translated title can read as a protected professional title (e.g. German Facharzt titles). No profile URL: hairgenetix.com/pages/esther-bodde 404s (found 2026-09-22), so the JSON-LD Person carries no url/sameAs. Updated 2026-09-23: the Argireline hub's overview is now a custom-html section, so its byline path is the two-part 'overview.html' and its JSON-LD host is 'evidence_sources' (the References section was absorbed into the evidence table and removed). set-reviewer.py gained byline_settings() to resolve section-level paths; without it --remove failed on that hub.
